Game Overview

Firefighter Rescue Quest puts players into a brain experience centered on become the ultimate hero in Firefighter Rescue Quest by strategically crafting paths for brave firefighters across treacherous rivers. Navigate through 40 increasingly challenging levels, using quick thinking and precision to ensure safety as you race against time. Can you master the puzzle to save the day?
